# Mateu

> Model-driven UI system for business apps. Declare the model once — as code (Java with @UI, C# with [UI], Python with @ui) or as data (YAML specs) — and Mateu derives forms, CRUD screens, navigation, wizards and full app shells, rendered on the web and natively, served by a backend or shipped as a static bundle. Zero frontend code for typical business apps.

Mateu works with Spring Boot (MVC and WebFlux), Quarkus, Micronaut, and Helidon. The frontend ships as pre-built Lit web-components; renderers for Vaadin (Lumo) and Oracle Redwood (on Oracle Visual Builder) are included.

## AI reference files

For AI-assisted development, use these context documents with your AI tool (Claude Projects, Gemini Gems, Cursor Rules, etc.):

- [Compact reference](https://mateu.io/mateu-ai-compact.md): ~2 500 tokens — key annotations, patterns, return types. Use for day-to-day code generation.
- [Full reference](https://mateu.io/mateu-ai-full.md): ~9 000 tokens — complete annotation catalogue, all interfaces, all UX patterns. Use for thorough assistance or broad feature coverage.
- Claude Code / Claude Agent SDK: a bundled skill at `.claude/skills/mateu/` auto-activates for Mateu tasks (progressive disclosure). See [Use Mateu with AI assistants](https://mateu.io/ai-assistant-reference/).

## Documentation

- [Quickstart](https://mateu.io/java-user-manual/start-here/quickstart/): A complete Spring Boot CRUD app in six files (the `starters/spring-mvc` project; `starters/` has one per runtime, incl. C# and Python)
- [Quickstart: YAML only](https://mateu.io/java-user-manual/start-here/quickstart-yaml/): An app with no UI code — specs/ui served by Spring Boot, or a static bundle with no backend
- [Create your project](https://mateu.io/java-create-your-project/): New project from IntelliJ (File › New › Project › Mateu), VS Code (Mateu: New Project) or Maven (io.mateu:mateu-archetype); generated projects carry AGENTS.md + CLAUDE.md
- [First app](https://mateu.io/java-user-manual/start-here/first-app/): Build your first form and CRUD
- [Annotations reference](https://mateu.io/java-ui-definition/annotations/): Every annotation with attributes and examples
- [Interfaces reference](https://mateu.io/java-ui-definition/interfaces/): Listing, CrudStore, BannerSupplier, BadgeSupplier, etc.
- [UX patterns](https://mateu.io/ux-patterns/): Wizard, high-density screens, split view, autosave, keyboard shortcuts, and more
- [Components](https://mateu.io/java-ui-definition/components/): Badge, Banner, FAB, Chart, Map, and all fluent components
- [Design systems](https://mateu.io/design-systems/): Vaadin, Oracle Redwood
- [Deploy to production](https://mateu.io/java-user-manual/build/deploy-to-production/): packaging, proxies, auth, CSP, CORS, static bundles
- [Stability & versioning](https://mateu.io/reference/stability-and-versioning/) and [Migrating from alpha](https://mateu.io/reference/migrating-from-alpha/): what is public API; every rename (CrudRepository→CrudStore, @Route removed → routes.yaml, ListingBackend→Listing, …)

## Key concepts

- `@UI("/path")` on a class registers it as a routed view; no path means root.
- Fields → form fields. `List<T>` fields → grids/tables. Nested class fields → subforms.
- Methods annotated with `@Button` or `@Toolbar` become buttons.
- Bean validation (`@NotNull`, `@NotEmpty`, `@Min`, `@Max`) is enforced client-side and server-side automatically.
- `HttpRequest` can be added to any method signature; Mateu injects it.
- Action methods return: `void` (stay), `URI` (navigate), `Message` (toast), any Java object (open as view), `PageBanner` (show banner), `new State(this)` (update without navigating).
- CRUD: extend `AutoCrud<T>` (T a record implementing `Identifiable`) and override the one mandatory method, `store()`, returning a `CrudStore<T>` (findById, save, findAll, deleteAllById).
- Custom listings: implement `Listing<Row>` (+ `Searchable`/`Filterable<F>` capabilities) and its `search(SearchRequest, HttpRequest)`.
- Wizard: extend `Wizard`, declare `WizardStep` fields, annotate the final action with `@WizardCompletionAction`.
- Dense screens: combine `@Compact` + `@Zones`/`@Zone` + `@Section(zone="...")`.
- Dynamic banners: `@Banner` on a method or implement `BannerSupplier`.
- Header badges: `@BadgeInHeader` on a field or implement `BadgeSupplier`.
- Floating buttons: `@Fab(icon="vaadin:plus")` on a method (app-level = global, page-level = scoped).
- Dark/light mode toggle: `@App(themeToggle=true)`.
- Unsaved-changes guard: `@ConfirmOnNavigationIfDirty` warns before leaving a modified form (menu, browser back/forward, reload/close); use `UICommand.markAsClean()` / `markAsDirty()` to control the state.
- Money formatting: `@Stereotype(FieldStereotype.money)` formats a numeric read-only/plain-text field as a currency amount.
- Expression labels: any label supports `${state.field}` template expressions.
- URL pagination: CRUD pages sync `?page=N&sort=field:asc` to the URL automatically.
